title: Bot chat pane runs under the Duo's right-hand system column
where: Homeroom bot tab, right chat pane: Send button, 'Live >' chevron, 'New' divider label, row chevrons
why: Every other Duo-sideways screen stops its content (and the header's bell/avatar) before the 84pt clock/Wi-Fi column, but the bot's chat pane is drawn to the screen edge. The round Send button (~891-931pt), the 'Live' chevron and the 'New' label all sit inside the system column, so the primary control is under the clock and Wi-Fi strip, in both the resting and keyboard states.

title: Messages tab stuck on the launch splash on Pro Max
where: Whole screen
why: The Messages capture shows only the Homeroom wordmark on a blank cream background: no header, no list, no tab bar. The same tab draws its list on every other shape, and the Pro Max DM and group screens load, so on this run Messages never got past the splash (or reloaded back to it) after switching tabs.

title: Settings is cramped on iPad portrait: your own name shows as 'A…'
where: Settings: sidebar + settings list + detail pane
why: With all three columns open, the iPad-portrait detail card truncates the profile to 'A…' / '@a…' and the email to 'audit_ada@audit.t…', and the list cuts 'Linked ph…', 'Agent instructions…', 'Experimen…' and wraps 'INTEGRATIONS & AUTOMATION'; the Duo sideways cuts the same labels. The sidebar should collapse or the list should stand alone at these widths. The selected row is 'Account' but the pane opens on a large 'Profile' heading, followed by 'Sign-in' and 'Delete account' at the same size, and the header puts a sidebar toggle and a back button side by side.

title: Pro Max shows false empty states while data is still loading
where: Discover list; Homeroom bot NEEDS YOU card; Home skeleton; bell
why: Discover says 'No apps to show yet.' although every other device lists 11+ apps; the bot shows a 'NEEDS YOU' card with an empty body and no subtitle, chips or + button; the bell has no badge. A slow load should look like loading, not like a final 'nothing here'. Where a skeleton does show (Home), it draws two rows of four icons and full-width bars, unlike the real one row of tiles and square cards, so the page jumps on arrival.

title: Floating members and ••• buttons sit on top of messages
where: Group and direct-message conversations, top right just under the header
why: On phone widths and the Duo upright the members and overflow buttons float over the scrolling conversation instead of living in the header, and cover the sender line: '@audit_ad[icon]14[•••]' on the mini and Pro Max, audit_ada's '9:14 PM' on the Duo. On the wide layouts the same buttons sit inside the conversation header and cover nothing. On the Duo upright the ••• also sits directly under the clock band.

title: Duo upright header: Messages has no title, others centre or left-align at random
where: Top header on the unfolded Duo, upright
why: Messages shows only the bell and avatar, with an empty left half and no title. Home, Discover, Communities, Homeroom bot, Profile, Settings and Challenges centre their title on the full width while the bell/avatar are pushed left of the clock, so 'Homeroom bot' crowds the bell and the left side is empty. Conversations, hubs and the App view left-align instead. Phones and iPad always left-align.

title: 'Neighbourhood Swap' breaks mid-word under its home icon
where: Home, My apps row, third tile label
why: The label wraps as 'Neighbourh / ood Swap'. It should wrap at the space or truncate. On the mini 'New project' also drops to two lines, so the four labels no longer share a baseline.

title: Discover rows on phones split title from subtitle and drop the Join button
where: Discover, ALL APPS list rows
why: At 375-393pt each row is ~96pt tall: the title sits at the top, 'Updated 52m ago' falls ~37pt below it and the Join pill lines up with the subtitle, below the icon's centre. On the Duo upright the same row is compact (title over subtitle, Join centred). The phone version looks like a wrapping bug and fits half as many apps.

title: Discover grid on iPad portrait truncates 'Updated 1h …' and wraps names
where: Discover, two-column app cards
why: The cards are too narrow for icon, text and Join: 'Group challenge', 'Sign-up sheet', 'Potluck planner' and 'Lending library' wrap to two lines and every subtitle is cut to 'Updated 1h …'; the Homeroom card cuts to 'The communi…'. The Duo sideways wraps the same names. iPad sideways fits the same grid, so portrait needs one column or a smaller Join.

title: Discover search and tabs end short of the list below
where: Discover: search field and For you / Browse / Joined control vs the list or grid
why: On the Duo upright the search and segmented control stop ~70pt before the right edge of the ALL APPS card; on iPad sideways they stop ~320pt before the grid's right edge. The ragged right edge looks unfinished; on phones and iPad portrait they line up.

title: iPhone mini cuts the information people need and the tab labels touch
where: Communities rows and chips, project header, Settings subtitles, bot chips, tab bar
why: At 375pt Book Club's subtitle becomes '1 in progress · 2 n…' (the '2 new messages' is lost behind the '1 to vote' pill; it is already cut to '2 new …' on the 393pt phone), the 'Just you 1' chip is cut at the edge, the project header reads 'Neighbourhood Sw…', Settings subtitles end 'signed in w…' and 'ChatGPT …', the bot's chip reads 'Watering Rot'. In the tab bar 'Homeroom bot' runs into the lit Messages pill with no gap, so neighbouring targets visually merge.

title: Communities tab icon is boxed and its label sits lower than the others
where: Bottom tab bar, second item
why: Every tab is a bare line icon except Communities, which is drawn inside a rounded-square outline. The taller icon pushes its label ~3pt below Home, Homeroom bot, Messages and You, so the row's baseline is uneven on every phone and the Duo upright.

title: Badges move and change colour between screens and layouts
where: Tab bar Communities badge and icon; sidebar rows
why: The tab bar puts its '1' on Communities, while the sidebar shows a '1' on Homeroom bot and nothing on Communities. On the Pro Max the lit Communities badge is blue; on the 393pt phone it is grey in the same state. On hub pages the tab icon turns into the project's 'B' tile, on the request page it does not. One count should sit in one place with one look.

title: Screens disagree about what is waiting and what is in progress
where: Communities Needs you, Book Club hub FOR YOU, bot header, profile stats
why: In the same phone run Communities says '1 vote waiting on you · Book Club' and the bot lists a Vote, but Book Club's own hub says 'Nothing more to vote on.' The hub says 'Your work · 1 in progress' while the bot header says 'In progress: 0'. The profile says '0 live' while the bot lists Watering Rota under 'Live this week'. People cannot tell which number to trust.

title: Zero counts are spelled out instead of hidden
where: Bot header subtitle, profile stat tiles, vote chips
why: House style is counts as words and zero shows nothing. The bot reads 'Needs you: 1 · In progress: 0' (label-colon-number), the profile leads with two large '0 live' / '0 challenges' tiles, and the vote row shows 'Yes (0)' and 'No (0)'.

title: Vote tallies read '2 of 1 yes vote', '2/1 yes' and '1/2'
where: Request #1 thread: vote chip and the change header pill
why: Once passed, the chip says '2 of 1 yes vote' (more than needed, singular) and the change header 'Live · 2/1 yes'. Earlier it read '0 of 2 yes votes', then 'Goes live in ~2d 23h · 1/2' beside 'Any of the 3 members can give it'. The threshold seems to change from 2 to 1 and is written four ways. The vote row also mixes purple-outline, blue, green and red pills, and on 375-393pt phones 'No (0)' wraps to a line of its own.

title: Request page header says 'Hub' and adds a second back button
where: Top of the request page
why: The header reads 'Book Club / Hub' while the page is Request #1 in the Workshop, and a '< Workshop' pill sits directly under the header's own back button. Two back controls with different targets, and a subtitle naming the wrong place.

title: Request timeline uses internal words: issue, homeroom_bot, Change #3
where: Request thread event lines and change header
why: Lines read 'audit_ada created issue: …' and 'homeroom_bot asked for approval … on Change #3' on a page titled 'Request #1', with 'Homeroom bot' two lines below; the wide layout prints 'CHANGE #3 · HOMEROOM_BOT' in caps. A '1 reply' / '2 replies' divider sits above five to nine events. Three numbering schemes and two names for the bot.

title: Jump-to-latest button covers request text on the Duo
where: Request thread, centre of the content just above the Reply box
why: The round down-chevron sits on the words 'members suggest' in the 'Built from the plan' line, and with the keyboard up on 'the top' in the request description. It needs to clear the text or sit in a margin.

title: Group chat is filed under Direct messages, and phone rows lose time and group cues
where: Messages list and the sidebar's Messages tree
why: Flat 4B is a 3-member group but sits under DIRECT MESSAGES (and 'Direct messages' in the sidebar). On phones and the Duo upright the rows are bare text on the background with regular-weight titles, a single avatar and no time; on wide layouts the same list is a card with bold titles, stacked avatars, a '3' members chip and '47m ago'. The narrow version drops exactly the cues that tell a group from a person.

title: Apps, projects and communities are named inconsistently
where: Home section titles, Discover, Communities filters, hub subtitle
why: Home shows 'My apps' with a 'New project' tile, then 'Discover Communities' whose cards are apps ('Updated 52m ago · 1 contributor'). Discover's For you lists 'ALL APPS' under 'Browse apps and communities…'. Communities filters by 'Public / Private / Just you', while Book Club, an invited group, calls itself 'Private community'. The product's terms are Just you / Group / Community, and project.

title: Home's section titles break the small-caps label rule
where: Home: 'My apps', 'Discover Communities', 'Challenges'
why: Every other screen labels sections in small bold caps (NEEDS YOU, YOUR WORK, the sidebar's COMMUNITIES). Home uses three large bold headings instead and mixes sentence case ('My apps') with title case ('Discover Communities'), so one page carries three competing large headings.

title: On phones the App view has no Suggest button and no way to the hub
where: Project App view header
why: On the Duo upright and every sidebar layout the header has a 'Suggest' pill (and the sidebar lists Hub, Needs you, Workshop). On every phone the header has only X, the name, bell and avatar: no Suggest, no switch to Hub or Workshop, and the tab bar is hidden. The starter screen itself tells people to tap the Homeroom icon and choose Suggest an improvement.

title: Black and grey blocks drawn over the day buttons on iPhone mini
where: Watering Rota app, 'Your days' row: Wed and Fri
why: A solid black square covers the 'd' of 'Wed' and a grey square covers the 'F' of 'Fri', and the seven buttons are squeezed to ~1pt gaps. The same screen renders cleanly on the other phones, so this looks like a paint glitch in the app frame at 375pt.

title: Workshop and Proposals open the Hub, and phones have no Workshop switch
where: Project page
why: The 'workshop' and 'proposals' screens show the Book Club Hub on every device (header 'Hub', sidebar lights 'Hub'). On phones the hub has no Hub / Workshop switch at all and 'All in Workshop >' appears only on wide layouts, so the only route is the 'Your work' row. Workshop is hard to reach, or links to it land on the wrong tab.

title: Hub cards nearly touch the screen edge on phones
where: Book Club hub FOR YOU and RECENTLY LIVE cards; request card
why: The cards start ~5pt from the screen edge while the hero above sits at 12pt and the section labels at ~8pt; Communities, Profile and Settings cards use a 16pt gutter. Three left edges on one page, and the hub looks wider than every other screen.

title: Bot list column is squeezed on wide layouts and shows a stray scrollbar
where: Homeroom bot, middle list column
why: On Duo sideways and iPad portrait the column is ~245pt: 'Homeroom bot' wraps onto two lines beside the + button, the project chips are cut to a bare 'W', and Live rows end 'Let members sugg…'. A grey scrollbar thumb stays visible between list and chat on all three wide shapes. iPad sideways fits, so the column needs a minimum width or the sidebar should collapse.

title: Bot chat shows one request as ready, live and still being read
where: Main Chat: Book Club change card and the thread row under the New divider
why: The card is titled 'Your change to Book Club is ready to try' and ends 'It's live.'; directly below, the same request #1 shows a spinner and 'Reading the request · 8 updates'; the list header says 'In progress: 0'. Three statuses for one request on one screen. The 9:28 PM time also floats alone in the left gutter beside the card.

title: Page titles repeated two or three times
where: Bot tab header and first card; hub header, Hub heading and hero
why: The bot tab says 'Homeroom bot' in the header and again as a large heading in the first card. The hub shows 'Book Club' in the header, as the hero heading and as the Recently live caption, and wide layouts add a separate large 'Hub' heading above it. The rule is one large heading per page.

title: Settings rows: a bookmark on every row squeezes the subtitles
where: Settings list rows and search field
why: Each row ends with a chevron and then a bookmark, so the text column loses ~60pt and the 393pt phone shows 'GitHub and X, for your weekly cr…', 'Phones signed in with …', 'Build from Claude, ChatGPT or a…', 'Tell your coding agents how to w…'. The list also departs from the house list: white cards, regular-weight titles, and a grey filled, square-cornered search field unlike the white pill search on Communities and Messages.

title: Carousel edge fade cuts a Join button to 'Joi'
where: Home, Discover Communities carousel right edge
why: The fade over the last visible card swallows half its Join pill ('+ Joi' on iPad portrait, a lone '+' on iPad sideways); on the mini the second card's Join is clipped by the screen edge. A peeking card is fine; a half button reads as broken.

title: Wide Home spreads four app icons across the width; content column jumps between tabs
where: Home My apps row; content alignment across tabs
why: On iPad sideways and the Duo upright the four tiles are spaced 157-220pt apart, so the row reads as four lone icons rather than a grid, and the lower half of Home is empty. On iPad sideways Home and Discover hug the left of the content area while Communities and Messages centre a narrower column, so content shifts sideways when switching tabs.

title: The same 'no challenges' empty state has two looks
where: Challenges page vs Home's Challenges card
why: Home shows a white card 'No challenges right now / New ones will show up here.'; the Challenges page shows a bare grey line 'No challenges right now.' under the tabs with the rest of the screen empty and nothing to do next.

title: Request card ends in a hard square edge with the keyboard up
where: Request page, bottom of the thread card above the keyboard; sticky title
why: The card's top corners are rounded but it is cut off square under the Reply box with a drop shadow, like a torn sheet. Above, the sticky title slices the first visible line in half (the bot's avatar and 'suggest a book and vote on the next' on the mini) with no fade or divider.

title: Unexplained grey dot on the sidebar's App row
where: Sidebar project tree, lit App row
why: A grey dot sits at the right end of the App row for every project. Status dots are meant only for something wrong; an unlabelled grey dot reads as an unread or error marker that never clears.
